placements.why: The envelope introduces an operational domain around public bicycle repair stands, location selection, and tool loss prevention that is distinct from existing facility, library, and transit strata.
placements.title: Public bicycle repair stand installation and equipment safeguarding
placements.frame: How should public bicycle repair stands and shared tools be installed, located, and secured?

placements.title: Siting public repair amenities at incident hotspots and securing equipment against theft
placements.frame: Where should public bicycle repair amenities be placed to address empirical failure points, and how should shared tools be physically secured?
placements.why: Captures the operational decision to place repair infrastructure directly where flats occur (river path entrance rather than car park) combined with physical tethering to preempt tool theft.
